show_hn.story_text: Hey HN, I’m Oskar, one of the co-founders of TesterArmy. We built an agentic testing framework for web and mobile because traditional testing frameworks can’t keep up with the pace of how we build software today. e2e allows you to mix deterministic and agentic APIs in the same test. You can write the test cases using familiar APIs like `getByText()`or `getByTestId()` which you can also mix it with agentic `agent.act()`. The unique part about it is that e2e will cache and replay the agentic actions so you don’t have to pay for AI on each run. You can use it with any LLM, including subscriptions you are already paying for. On top of that, the core of e2e is platform agnostic. show_hn.title: Show HN: Krashout, multiplayer car soccer in the browser
show_hn.story_text: Hey HN, I built this after looking for an easy to pick up game with a deceptively high skill ceiling - something we could play at remote friendly end of work drinks. I ended up with something in between TagPro and Rocket League. I was particularly interested in making it playable on poor and patchy connections, so spent a bunch of time on prediction, especially around player-to-player collisions. Each game runs in its own Cloudflare Durable Object near the players in an attempt to minimize average room latency. There’s ranked (using Glicko-2), casual (bots fill empty seats), private games you can share with a link, and some basic stat tracking. No sign up needed to play: WASD to drive, shift to boost, and space to shoot. Lemme know what you think and please share any and all feedback!
